title: Nonholonomic billiards and bounded motion in cylinders
summary: A widely used mathematical model for the bouncing motion of an ideally elastic ball -- referred to in previous work by the first two authors and collaborators as a {\em no-slip billiard} system -- exhibits some notable dynamical behavior that is not well-understood. For example, under certain initial conditions, the axial component of the position of the center of the ball moving inside a vertical solid cylinder under constant gravitational force does not accelerate downward as might be expected but remains bounded.
